Only the patch is available. Other code in mock.go (such as MethodCalled) may also use the mutex, but I can't see it.

The change to `AssertExpectationsForObjects` is the main problem. It now matches `*Mock` instead of `Mock`. A caller who passes `myMock.Mock` by value, as the deprecation message describes, no longer matches the type check. The code then reaches `obj.(assertExpectationser)`. `Mock` has pointer-receiver methods, so a value doesn't implement the interface and the assertion panics. Passing a `*Mock` now logs a deprecation message, even though that is the correct usage.
